newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Star Enter proposes 8-for-1 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Star Enter proposes 8-for-1 rights issue.

text.p: Star Entertainment (International Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it proposed to raise HK$268.8 million through a rights issue on the basis of eight-for-one at HK$0.10 per rights share.

It said the issue price represented a discount of 81.5 percent to the closing price of the company's shares of HK$0.54 last Friday, and a discount of 32.9 percent to the theoretical ex-rights price of HK$0.149 based on that closing price.
The proceeds would be used to finance film production, to secure distribution rights, to finance or purchase rights to distribute TV drama series and to build a video library.
Star Entertainment also said it had reached a supply agreement with Win's Entertainment Co Ltd, an associate of its new controling sharesholder Dorest Co Ltd on September 7.

Under the agreement Star Entertainment would have an exclusive right to acquire worldwide distribution rights in each film and TV drama series produced and or to be produced by Win's and its subsidiaries for a period of three years.
The agreement would depend on a waiver from stock exchange requirements for disclosure and compliance under the Listing Rules in relation to connected transactions, the company said.
The rights issue was conditional upon the supply agreement becoming unconditional and subject to shareholders' approval, Star Entertainment said.
Major shareholder Dorest Co Ltd, which made a buyout offer for Star Entertainment in June at HK$0.279 a share, has agreed to accept all the rights shares to be allotted to it under the rights issue.
Dorest holds 41.90 percent of Star Entertainment, a vendor and distributor of video tapes, films and karaoke laser discs.
